title: Privacy Policy

summary.title: In short
items: The only personal information we ask for is your **name** and your **email address**.
We use them to run your account, and for nothing else. No advertising, no tracking, no selling.
You can download everything we hold about you, or delete it all, any time in **Settings**.

blocks.text: This policy explains how Language Tutor (“the app”) handles your personal information. The app is run by the person or organisation that installed it (“the operator”), not by a large company. You can contact the operator at {contact}.
blocks.text_without_contact: This policy explains how Language Tutor (“the app”) handles your personal information. The app is run by the person or organisation that installed it (“the operator”), not by a large company. For questions about your data, contact the person who gave you access to this app.

blocks.text: Your **name** and **email address** are the only information that identifies you. Everything else in the table is either something you choose to type in, or a technical record needed to keep you signed in, or a display preference you choose.

blocks.caption: Information the app stores
head: Information
What it is used for
rows: Your name
The name you enter at sign-up. Shown in the app so it can greet you. You can change it.
Your email address
How you sign in, and the way the operator can contact you about your account. You can change it.
Your password
Stored only as a scrambled one-way hash, made with a random salt that belongs to your account alone. Nobody, including the operator, can read it.
Words, meanings and stories you add

To run the learning features. This is your own study material. A story you make in Story Studio is kept only if you choose Save to library; then it is stored with its quality report (what the checker found), and nothing else about it.
Your chat with the tutor

What you type to the tutor, and its replies, are stored (in the operator’s tutor service) in chat sessions, so a conversation can continue. The app also keeps a list of your chat session codes, so that deleting your account can delete those chats. Chats are not shown to anyone else.
The languages you study
To show the right word list.
Your display preferences
Your theme and colours, the language you are studying now, and whether the site is shown in that language. Saved on your account so they follow you to any device. You can change them in Settings.
Your own AI model (only if the operator switches it on for your account and you set it up)

The model name and model address you enter, and your API key. The key is stored encrypted on the server and is never shown again, only its last four characters. You can remove all of it in Settings, My model.
Sign-in records
When each sign-in started and when it ends, plus a random code. Used to keep you signed in and to let you sign out of every device. Removed when you sign out or they expire.
Proof you accepted this policy
The date, and which version of this policy, you accepted when you signed up.

blocks.text: We do **not** collect your phone number, address, date of birth, location, payment details, or advertising identifiers.

Only to provide the app: to create your account, sign you in, greet you by name, keep your words separate from everyone else’s, let you download or delete your data, and protect accounts (for example, by pausing sign-in after repeated wrong passwords).

We do not use your information for advertising or profiling, we do not sell it, and no decisions about you are made automatically. The app does not send you any email at the moment. If that ever changes (for example, to reset a forgotten password), the email will only be about your account, and this policy will be updated first.

The app sets **one cookie**, which keeps you signed in. It is strictly necessary, cannot be read by page scripts, and lasts until you sign out or up to 8 hours. There are no analytics, advertising or third-party cookies.

Your display preferences are saved on your account, not only in your browser. Your browser also keeps a temporary copy of them (your theme, colours and language choices) so the page can open in your colours without a flash. The copy is removed when you sign out. On the sign-in and policy pages, the light/dark switch is remembered for the current tab only. Nothing else about you is kept in the browser.
We do not sell or give your information to anyone for their own purposes. Two things to know:

items: **AI features.** Chat is available when the operator has switched it on. The words and messages you type in Chat, and the words from your list that Story Studio uses (a random selection if your list is long) together with the kind of story and topic you pick, are sent to an AI service (Groq) so it can write a reply or story. Your name and email address are **not** sent. A story you do not save is not kept by the app.

**Your own AI model.** If you choose to use your own AI model, your words and story requests are sent to the provider you name, and your API key is stored encrypted on our server. That provider has its own privacy rules, which this policy does not cover. Nothing is sent to it unless you set it up.
**Where it is stored.** Your information lives in a database run by the operator. If the law requires it, the operator may have to disclose information to the authorities.

blocks.text: Until you delete your account. Deleting your account (Settings → Delete account) permanently removes your name, email, password hash, words, languages, saved stories, display preferences, chat history and sign-in records straight away. If your chat history cannot be removed at that moment, nothing is deleted and you are asked to try again, so your account is never left half-deleted. The app itself keeps no backups. If the operator makes database backups, deleted information can remain in them until they expire; ask the operator how long.

items: **See and take your data:** Settings → Data & privacy → Download my data (a file you can open or move elsewhere; for chat it lists your chat sessions and when they started, but not the messages, which stay in the tutor service until you delete your account).
**Correct it:** change your name, email, password or display preferences in Settings.
**Withdraw consent:** you can delete your account at any time. Nothing is held back.

blocks.text: Depending on where you live (for example under the EU/UK GDPR or California law) you may have further rights, such as asking the operator to restrict how your data is used, or complaining to your local data protection authority. Contact the operator to use them.

Passwords are stored as hashes. Each account can only reach its own data, and this is tested automatically. Signing out ends the sign-in on the server, and you can end every sign-in at once. Repeated wrong passwords temporarily lock sign-in. No system is perfectly secure. Whoever runs the app is responsible for serving it over HTTPS whenever it is reachable over a network.
The app is not meant for children under 16. If you are younger, please ask a parent or guardian before creating an account.
When this policy changes in a way that matters, the version above changes. When you sign up, the app records which version you accepted.
This policy may be available as a separate copy in other languages. Each copy is checked by a person before it is shown. If copies ever disagree, the English copy governs.

blocks.text_without_contact: Questions or requests: contact the person who runs this installation of the app.

governing: If copies of this policy in different languages disagree, the English copy governs.
